ActivateBehaviorDefinition.semantic: Activate a RAP behavior definition after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateClass.semantic: Activate an ABAP class after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateDataElement.semantic: Activate an ABAP data element after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateDdl.semantic: Activate a CDS view after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateDomain.semantic: Activate an ABAP domain after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateFunctionGroup.semantic: Activate an ABAP function group after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateFunctionModule.semantic: Activate an ABAP function module (BAPI or RFC function) after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateInterface.semantic: Activate an ABAP interface after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateMetadataExtension.semantic: Activate a CDS metadata extension after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateObjects.semantic: Activate several objects together in one activation, for example all inactive objects.

ActivateProgram.semantic: Activate an ABAP program (report) once it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateServiceBinding.semantic: Activate an OData service binding after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateServiceDefinition.semantic: Activate a service definition after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateStructure.semantic: Activate an ABAP DDIC structure after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

ActivateTable.semantic: Activate an ABAP database table after it was created or changed, so the change is in force.

AddTransportObject.semantic: Add a class, program or other object to a transport request or task, so it is transported with it.

AmdpDebugCancel.semantic: Cancel the execution of the AMDP method being debugged.

AmdpDebugGetTable.semantic: Show the rows of a table variable where the AMDP method stopped.

AmdpDebugSetBreakpoints.semantic: Set the breakpoints of an AMDP debug session.

AmdpDebugStart.semantic: Start debugging an AMDP method (SQLScript) with breakpoints on its lines.

AmdpDebugStep.semantic: Step the stopped AMDP method over a statement or to the next stop.

AmdpDebugStop.semantic: Stop debugging the AMDP method and end the AMDP debug session.

AmdpDebugWait.semantic: Wait until the AMDP method being debugged stops at an SQLScript breakpoint.

BatchAnswers.semantic: Read the answers of the calls of the last batch by their number.

BatchBegin.semantic: Start batch mode: record several independent calls to send them together.

BatchEnd.semantic: Send the recorded calls together in one request and end batch mode.

CheckBehaviorDefinition.semantic: Run a syntax check on a RAP behavior definition and see its errors and warnings.

CheckClass.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP class and see its errors and warnings.

CheckDataElement.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP data element and see its errors and warnings.

CheckDdl.semantic: Run a syntax check on a CDS view and see its errors and warnings.

CheckDomain.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP domain and see its errors and warnings.

CheckFunctionGroup.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP function group and see its errors and warnings.

CheckFunctionModule.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP function module (BAPI or RFC function) and see its errors and warnings.

CheckInterface.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP interface and see its errors and warnings.

CheckMetadataExtension.semantic: Run a syntax check on a CDS metadata extension and see its errors and warnings.

CheckPackage.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP package and see its errors and warnings.

CheckProgram.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP program (report) and see its errors and warnings.

CheckStructure.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP DDIC structure and see its errors and warnings.

CheckTable.semantic: Run a syntax check on an ABAP database table and see its errors and warnings.

CreateBehaviorDefinition.semantic: Create a new RAP behavior definition for a CDS root entity of a RAP business object, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateBehaviorImplementation.semantic: Create a new RAP behavior implementation class for a behavior definition, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateCdsUnitTest.semantic: Write ABAP Unit tests for a CDS view with CDS test doubles.

CreateClass.semantic: Create a new global ABAP class with any name, a test helper class included, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateDataElement.semantic: Create a new ABAP data element with its type and field labels, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateDdl.semantic: Create a new CDS view that selects from a table or another CDS view, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateDomain.semantic: Create a new ABAP domain with its data type and fixed values, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateFunctionGroup.semantic: Create a new ABAP function group, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateFunctionGroupUnitTest.semantic: Write ABAP Unit tests for a function group in a test include.

CreateFunctionInclude.semantic: Create a new include of an ABAP function group inside a function group, for shared declarations or form routines, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateFunctionModule.semantic: Create a new function module in a function group: an FM, BAPI or RFC-enabled function with its parameters.

CreateInterface.semantic: Create a new ABAP interface, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateMessageClass.semantic: Create a new ABAP message class, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateMessageClassMessage.semantic: Add a new message with a number and a text to an ABAP message class.

CreateMetadataExtension.semantic: Create a new CDS metadata extension with UI annotations for a CDS view, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreatePackage.semantic: Create a new ABAP package under a super-package, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateProgram.semantic: Create a new ABAP program (report), in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateProgramUnitTest.semantic: Write ABAP Unit tests for a report (program) in a test include.

CreateServiceBinding.semantic: Create a new OData service binding (OData V2 or V4) for a service definition, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateServiceDefinition.semantic: Create a new service definition that exposes CDS views as an OData service, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateStructure.semantic: Create a new ABAP DDIC structure with its fields (components), in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateTable.semantic: Create a new ABAP database table with its fields (columns) and key, in a package and recorded on a transport request.

CreateTransport.semantic: Create a new transport request (workbench or customizing) to record changes.

CreateTransportTask.semantic: Create a new task under a transport request for a user.

CreateUnitTest.semantic: Write ABAP Unit tests for a class: its local test classes.

DebugBatchBegin.semantic: Start recording debugger calls at the stopped program to send them together.

DebugBatchEnd.semantic: Send the recorded debugger calls together and end the debugger batch.

DebugCreateMemorySnapshot.semantic: Write a memory snapshot of the program stopped in the debugger.

DebugCreateWatchpoint.semantic: Watch a variable and stop when its value changes.

DebugDeleteBreakpoint.semantic: Remove one breakpoint from a debug session.

DebugGetMemorySizes.semantic: Show how much memory the program stopped in the debugger uses.

DebugGetStack.semantic: Show the call stack of the program stopped in the debugger.

DebugGetVariables.semantic: Show the values of variables of the program stopped in the debugger.

DebugListBreakpoints.semantic: List the breakpoints of a debug session.

DebugListWatchpoints.semantic: List the watchpoints of the program stopped in the debugger.

DebugSetBreakpoints.semantic: Set breakpoints in a debug session: on a line of a class or program, an exception, a statement or a message.

DebugSetSettings.semantic: Switch debugger settings at the current stop: system debugging, update debugging, exception objects, background RFC.

DebugSetStackPosition.semantic: Select a frame of the call stack to read its variables.

DebugSetVariable.semantic: Change the value of a variable of the program stopped in the debugger.

DebugStartListener.semantic: Start debugging: set breakpoints and wait for a program or class to stop at one.

DebugStep.semantic: Step through the program stopped in the debugger: into, over, out of a call, or continue.

DebugStepToLine.semantic: Run or jump the program stopped in the debugger to a line.

DebugStop.semantic: Stop debugging: release the program, remove the breakpoints and end the debug session.

DebugTakeOverListener.semantic: Start debugging and take over from another debugger that listens for the same user.

DebugTerminate.semantic: Terminate the program stopped in the debugger.

DebugWait.semantic: Wait until the debugged program stops at a breakpoint and see the debugger state.

DeleteBehaviorDefinition.semantic: Delete an existing RAP behavior definition from the system.

DeleteBehaviorImplementation.semantic: Delete an existing RAP behavior implementation class from the system.

DeleteCdsUnitTest.semantic: Delete the ABAP Unit test class of a CDS view.

DeleteClass.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP class from the system.

DeleteDataElement.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP data element from the system.

DeleteDdl.semantic: Delete an existing CDS view from the system.

DeleteDomain.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP domain from the system.

DeleteFunctionGroup.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP function group from the system.

DeleteFunctionInclude.semantic: Delete an existing include of an ABAP function group from the system.

DeleteFunctionModule.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP function module (BAPI or RFC function) from the system.

DeleteInterface.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP interface from the system.

DeleteLocalDefinitions.semantic: Clear the definitions include of a global class, so it holds no class-local definitions.

DeleteLocalMacros.semantic: Clear the macros include of a global class, so it holds no DEFINE macros.

DeleteLocalTestClass.semantic: Clear the test classes include of a global class, so it holds no ABAP Unit test classes.

DeleteLocalTypes.semantic: Clear the implementations include of a global class, so it holds no local helper classes or types.

DeleteMessageClass.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP message class from the system.

DeleteMessageClassMessage.semantic: Delete one message of an ABAP message class by its number.

DeleteMetadataExtension.semantic: Delete an existing CDS metadata extension from the system.

DeletePackage.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP package from the system.

DeleteProgram.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP program (report) from the system.

DeleteServiceBinding.semantic: Delete an existing OData service binding from the system.

DeleteServiceDefinition.semantic: Delete an existing service definition from the system.

DeleteStructure.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP DDIC structure from the system.

DeleteTable.semantic: Delete an existing ABAP database table from the system.

DeleteUnitTest.semantic: Delete the ABAP Unit test classes of a class, keeping the class.

DescribeByList.semantic: Describe several repository objects at once: their type, description and package.

DiscardBackgroundRun.semantic: Discard the kept result of a finished background run.

GetATCFindings.semantic: Show the findings of an ATC check run: the errors and warnings that ABAP Test Cockpit found.

GetATCRunStatus.semantic: Check whether an ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) run has finished.

GetAbapAST.semantic: Parse a piece of ABAP code into its abstract syntax tree.

GetAbapSemanticAnalysis.semantic: Analyze a piece of ABAP code: its symbols, types, scopes and dependencies.

GetAbapSystemSymbols.semantic: Resolve the symbols of a piece of ABAP code against the system: their types, descriptions and packages.

GetAdtTypes.semantic: List the ADT object types (CLAS, PROG, TABL, DDLS...) or check that a type code is valid.

GetBackgroundRun.semantic: Check one of my background runs and read its result when it has finished.

GetBehaviorDefinition.semantic: Show the source of a RAP behavior definition: its operations, actions, validations and determinations.

GetBehaviorDefinitionVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of a RAP behavior definition and see what changed between them.

GetBehaviorDefinitionVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of a RAP behavior definition.

GetBehaviorDefinitionVersions.semantic: List the version history of a RAP behavior definition: who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetBehaviorImplementation.semantic: Show the source code of a RAP behavior implementation class: its handler methods for actions, validations and determinations.

GetClass.semantic: Show the source code of an ABAP class: its methods and attributes.

GetClassVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of an ABAP class and see what changed between them.

GetClassVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of an ABAP class.

GetClassVersions.semantic: List the version history of an ABAP class: who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetDataElement.semantic: Show the definition of an ABAP data element: its domain, data type and field labels.

GetDdl.semantic: Show the DDL source of a CDS view: its fields, associations, joins and annotations.

GetDdlVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of a CDS view and see what changed between them.

GetDdlVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of a CDS view.

GetDdlVersions.semantic: List the version history of a CDS view: who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetDomain.semantic: Show the definition of an ABAP domain: its data type, length and fixed values.

GetEnhancementImpl.semantic: Read the source code of an enhancement implementation of an enhancement spot.

GetEnhancementSpot.semantic: Show an enhancement spot and the implementations that exist for it.

GetEnhancements.semantic: Find the enhancements (enhancement implementations, BAdIs) that exist in a program, include or class.

GetFunctionGroup.semantic: Show the definition of an ABAP function group: its package, description and contents.

GetFunctionInclude.semantic: Read the source code of an include that belongs to a function group.

GetFunctionModule.semantic: Show the source code of an ABAP function module (BAPI or RFC function): its parameters (importing, exporting, tables, exceptions) and logic.

GetFunctionModuleVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of an ABAP function module (BAPI or RFC function) and see what changed between them.

GetFunctionModuleVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of an ABAP function module (BAPI or RFC function).

GetFunctionModuleVersions.semantic: List the version history of an ABAP function module (BAPI or RFC function): who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetInactiveObjects.semantic: List the objects that are still inactive: changed but not yet activated.

GetInclude.semantic: Read the source code of an ABAP include program by its name.

GetIncludesList.semantic: List all includes that a program, include, function group or class is made of.

GetInterface.semantic: Show the source code of an ABAP interface: its methods and types.

GetInterfaceVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of an ABAP interface and see what changed between them.

GetInterfaceVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of an ABAP interface.

GetInterfaceVersions.semantic: List the version history of an ABAP interface: who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetLocalDefinitions.semantic: Read the class-local type and constant definitions of a global class, from its definitions include.

GetLocalMacros.semantic: Read the DEFINE macros that a global class declares in its macros include.

GetLocalTestClass.semantic: Read the ABAP Unit test classes that a global class declares locally, in its test classes include.

GetLocalTypes.semantic: Read the local helper classes and types that a global class declares in its implementations include.

GetMessageClass.semantic: Show the definition of an ABAP message class: its messages.

GetMessageClassMessage.semantic: Read one message of an ABAP message class by its number: its text.

GetMetadataExtension.semantic: Show the source of a CDS metadata extension: its UI annotations for Fiori elements.

GetMetadataExtensionVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of a CDS metadata extension and see what changed between them.

GetMetadataExtensionVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of a CDS metadata extension.

GetMetadataExtensionVersions.semantic: List the version history of a CDS metadata extension: who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetObjectInfo.semantic: Show the tree of a package, class, program or function group with its components.

GetObjectNodeFromCache.semantic: Read one node from the cached object list of an earlier walk.

GetObjectStructure.semantic: Show the structure of a repository object as a tree of its parts.

GetObjectVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of a repository object (program, class, include, CDS view...) and see what changed.

GetObjectVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of a repository object of any type.

GetObjectVersions.semantic: List the version history of a repository object of any type: who changed it, when, in which transport.

GetObjectsByType.semantic: List the objects of one type (all classes, all tables...) under a package or object.

GetObjectsList.semantic: List all objects below a package, program, function group or class, including nested ones.

GetPackage.semantic: Show the definition of an ABAP package: its description, super-package and sub-packages.

GetPackageContents.semantic: List the objects that a package contains, optionally with its subpackages.

GetPackageTree.semantic: Show the tree of a package: its subpackages and the objects in each.

GetProgram.semantic: Show the source code of an ABAP program (report): its logic.

GetProgramVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of an ABAP program (report) and see what changed between them.

GetProgramVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of an ABAP program (report).

GetProgramVersions.semantic: List the version history of an ABAP program (report): who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetServiceBinding.semantic: Show the definition of an OData service binding: its OData version, service definition and publication state.

GetServiceBindingPreviewUrl.semantic: Get the browser URL that previews an OData service binding in Fiori elements, and its service and $metadata URLs.

GetServiceDefinition.semantic: Show the source of a service definition: the CDS entities it exposes.

GetSqlQuery.semantic: Run an ABAP SQL SELECT over tables or CDS views, with a WHERE condition, and see the rows found.

GetStructure.semantic: Show the definition of an ABAP DDIC structure: its fields (components) and types.

GetStructureVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of an ABAP DDIC structure and see what changed between them.

GetStructureVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of an ABAP DDIC structure.

GetStructureVersions.semantic: List the version history of an ABAP DDIC structure: who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetStructuresList.semantic: List the structures included or appended in a DDIC structure, as a tree.

GetTable.semantic: Show the definition of an ABAP database table: its fields (columns), key fields and types.

GetTableContents.semantic: Show the rows (data) stored in a database table or returned by a CDS view, like SE16.

GetTableVersionDiff.semantic: Compare two versions of an ABAP database table and see what changed between them.

GetTableVersionSource.semantic: Read the source code of an earlier version of an ABAP database table.

GetTableVersions.semantic: List the version history of an ABAP database table: who changed it, when, and in which transport request.

GetTransaction.semantic: Show the properties of a transaction code (t-code): its text, type, package, application component and package chain.

GetTransport.semantic: Show a transport request: its description, owner, status, tasks and the objects it contains.

GetTypeInfo.semantic: Show what a DDIC type is: a domain, data element, table type or structure with its technical type.

GetUnitTestResult.semantic: Read the result of an ABAP Unit test run that was still running when it started.

GetWhereUsed.semantic: Who calls this method or function module (BAPI), and who uses this class, table, data element or CDS view: the where-used list of an object.

HandlerActivate.semantic: Activate one object or several objects together after a change.

HandlerBackgroundRunDiscard.semantic: Discard the kept result of a finished background run.

HandlerBackgroundRunGet.semantic: Check one of my background runs and read its result when it has finished.

HandlerBackgroundRunList.semantic: List my background runs and whether each is still running.

HandlerBatch.semantic: Record several independent calls and send them together in batch mode, then read their answers.

HandlerCdsUnitTestResult.semantic: Read the result of a CDS view unit test run.

HandlerCdsUnitTestStatus.semantic: Check whether a CDS view unit test run has finished.

HandlerCheckRun.semantic: Run a syntax check on a class, program, CDS view or other object and see its errors and warnings.

HandlerCreate.semantic: Create a new ABAP object: a class, program, CDS view, table, function module, package or another type.

HandlerDebugBatch.semantic: Record debugger calls at the stopped program and send them together.

HandlerDebugBreakpoints.semantic: Set, list or remove debugger breakpoints and watchpoints.

HandlerDebugMaintain.semantic: Show the call stack and variables of the program stopped in the debugger, or change a variable.

HandlerDebugSession.semantic: Start, wait for, or end a debug session of an ABAP program or AMDP method.

HandlerDebugStep.semantic: Step through the program stopped in the debugger.

HandlerDelete.semantic: Delete an ABAP object: a class, program, CDS view, table or another type.

HandlerDeletionCheck.semantic: Ask the system whether an object can be deleted before deleting it.

HandlerDumpList.semantic: Find the ABAP short dumps (runtime errors, crashes) of a program, a user or a time range; also system messages and SAP Gateway errors.

HandlerDumpView.semantic: Open one ABAP short dump by its id and see its details.

HandlerGet.semantic: Read the source code or metadata of any ABAP object: class, program, CDS view, table, function module, package and more.

HandlerGetData.semantic: Show the rows of a table or CDS view, or run an ABAP SQL SELECT.

HandlerLeftoverSessionList.semantic: List SAP sessions that an ended server process left open.

HandlerLeftoverSessionLogoff.semantic: Log off a leftover SAP session so that its locks are released.

HandlerLock.semantic: Lock an object before changing it and get its lock handle.

HandlerProfileList.semantic: List the ABAP profiler (SAT) traces that exist.

HandlerProfileRun.semantic: Run an ABAP class or program and see its output, optionally under the profiler or in the background.

HandlerProfileSchedule.semantic: Prepare an ABAP profiler (SAT) trace so the next run is measured.

HandlerProfileView.semantic: Read or analyze an ABAP profiler trace: the hit list, the statements, the database accesses.

HandlerSearch.semantic: Find repository objects by their name or a name pattern with wildcards.

HandlerServiceBindingListTypes.semantic: List the service binding types available, such as OData V2 or V4.

HandlerServiceBindingValidate.semantic: Check that a new service binding can be created with the given name and service definition.

HandlerSession.semantic: Open a long session: keep the server instance and its SAP connection for the calls that carry its state_handle; close it to log that SAP session off.

HandlerTransportCreate.semantic: Create a new transport request to record changes.

HandlerTransportMoveObjects.semantic: Move objects from one transport task to another.

HandlerTransportSortAndCompress.semantic: Sort the object list of a transport task and merge its duplicate entries.

HandlerUnitTestResult.semantic: Read the result of an ABAP Unit test run.

HandlerUnitTestRun.semantic: Run ABAP Unit tests of chosen test classes, or of one object of any run type or a package.

HandlerUnitTestStatus.semantic: Check whether an ABAP Unit test run has finished.

HandlerUnlock.semantic: Release the lock on an object after changing it.

HandlerUpdate.semantic: Change an existing ABAP object: write the new source code of a class, program, CDS view or another type.

HandlerValidate.semantic: Check that a new object can be created with the given name and package.

HandlerWhereUsed.semantic: Who calls this method or function module (BAPI), and who uses this class, table or CDS view: the where-used list of an object.

ListBackgroundRuns.semantic: List my background runs and whether each is still running or finished.

ListFunctionGroupIncludes.semantic: List the includes (TOP and custom includes) of a function group.

ListFunctionModules.semantic: List the function modules that belong to a function group.

ListLeftoverSessions.semantic: List SAP sessions that an ended server process left open, and the locks they may hold.

ListServiceBindingTypes.semantic: List the service binding types available, such as OData V2 or V4, UI or Web API.

ListTransports.semantic: List the transport requests of a user, for example my open (modifiable) requests.

LogoffLeftoverSession.semantic: Log off a leftover SAP session so that its locks are released.

MemorySnapshotDelta.semantic: Compare two memory snapshots to find what grew, for example a memory leak.

MemorySnapshotGet.semantic: Analyze a memory snapshot: memory by kind, the largest objects and their references.

MemorySnapshotList.semantic: List the memory snapshots that exist.

MoveTransportObjects.semantic: Move objects from one transport task to another task or request.

ReadTransportActionLog.semantic: Read the action log of a transport request: when it was created, which objects were added or deleted, owner changes.

ReadTransportObjects.semantic: List the objects that a transport request or task contains, each with its position in the object list.

RemoveTransportObject.semantic: Remove an object, such as a class, from a transport request.

RunATC.semantic: Run ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) quality checks over objects or a package.

RunAbapUnit.semantic: Run the ABAP Unit tests of a whole package, or of one object by its ABAP Unit run type such as a CDS view's assigned tests, and see which pass or fail.

RunCdsUnitTest.semantic: Run the ABAP Unit tests of a CDS view and see which pass or fail.

RunFunctionGroupUnitTest.semantic: Run all ABAP Unit tests of a function group and see which pass or fail.

RunFunctionModuleUnitTest.semantic: Run the ABAP Unit tests of a function module and see which pass or fail.

RunProgramUnitTest.semantic: Run the ABAP Unit tests of a report (program) and see which pass or fail.

RunUnitTest.semantic: Run the unit tests (ABAP Unit) of a class and show which tests pass or fail.

RuntimeAnalyzeProfilerTrace.semantic: Analyze an ABAP profiler trace: totals and the slowest statements or calls.

RuntimeCreateProfilerTraceParameters.semantic: Prepare an ABAP profiler (SAT) trace so the next run is measured for performance.

RuntimeGetDumpById.semantic: Open one ABAP short dump (runtime error) by its id and see its details.

RuntimeGetGatewayErrorLog.semantic: Show the SAP Gateway error log (/IWFND/ERROR_LOG) of OData services, or one error in detail.

RuntimeGetProfilerTraceData.semantic: Read the data of an ABAP profiler trace: the hit list, the statements, the database accesses.

RuntimeListFeeds.semantic: Find the ABAP short dumps (runtime errors, crashes) of a program, a user or a time range such as today or yesterday, and why it crashed; also system messages and SAP Gateway errors.

RuntimeListProfilerTraceFiles.semantic: List the ABAP profiler (SAT) trace files that exist.

RuntimeListSystemMessages.semantic: List the SM02 system messages announced to users.

RuntimeRunClass.semantic: Run an ABAP class that implements if_oo_adt_classrun and see its console output.

RuntimeRunProgram.semantic: Execute a report and see the list output it prints.

SearchObject.semantic: Find repository objects (classes, programs, tables...) by their name or a name pattern with wildcards.

SearchSource.semantic: Search the source code of the programs, classes and function groups in a package for a text or statement; a scan that stops early answers a cursor to continue from.

SessionClose.semantic: Close a long session: log off the SAP sessions of the server instance its state_handle names, which releases the locks taken in it.

SessionOpen.semantic: Open a long session: keep the server instance and its SAP connection for the calls that carry its state_handle.

SortAndCompressTransportTask.semantic: Sort the object list of a transport task and merge its duplicate entries.

UpdateBehaviorDefinition.semantic: Add an action, a validation or a determination to a RAP behavior definition: write its new source.

UpdateBehaviorImplementation.semantic: Implement an action, a validation or a determination in a RAP behavior implementation class: write its new source code.

UpdateCdsUnitTest.semantic: Replace the ABAP Unit test classes that test a CDS view.

UpdateClass.semantic: Edit an ABAP class and add a method to it, or change its source code.

UpdateDataElement.semantic: Change an ABAP data element: its field labels, domain or type.

UpdateDdl.semantic: Change the source of a CDS view: add a field, an association or a join, and write its new DDL source.

UpdateDomain.semantic: Change an ABAP domain: its fixed values, data type or length.

UpdateFunctionGroup.semantic: Change the description of an ABAP function group.

UpdateFunctionGroupUnitTest.semantic: Replace the ABAP Unit test classes of a function group.

UpdateFunctionInclude.semantic: Change the code of an include of an ABAP function group.

UpdateFunctionModule.semantic: Change an ABAP function module (BAPI or RFC function): write its new source code with its parameters.

UpdateInterface.semantic: Add or change a method of an ABAP interface: write its new source code.

UpdateLocalDefinitions.semantic: Write the class-local type and constant definitions of a global class, in its definitions include.

UpdateLocalMacros.semantic: Write the DEFINE macros that a global class declares in its macros include.

UpdateLocalTestClass.semantic: Write the ABAP Unit test classes that a global class declares locally, in its test classes include.

UpdateLocalTypes.semantic: Write the local helper classes and types that a global class declares in its implementations include.

UpdateMessageClass.semantic: Change the description of an ABAP message class.

UpdateMessageClassMessage.semantic: Change the text of an existing message of an ABAP message class.

UpdateMetadataExtension.semantic: Change the UI annotations of a CDS metadata extension: write its new source.

UpdatePackage.semantic: Change the description of an ABAP package.

UpdateProgram.semantic: Fix a bug in an ABAP report (program) and save its new source code.

UpdateProgramUnitTest.semantic: Replace the ABAP Unit test classes of a report (program).

UpdateServiceBinding.semantic: Publish or unpublish an OData service binding.

UpdateServiceDefinition.semantic: Expose another CDS entity in a service definition: write its new source.

UpdateStructure.semantic: Add or change a component of a DDIC structure: write its new definition.

UpdateTable.semantic: Add or change a field of an ABAP database table: write its new definition.

UpdateUnitTest.semantic: Replace the ABAP Unit test classes of a class with new ones.

ValidateServiceBinding.semantic: Check that a new service binding can be created with the given name, service definition and package.
